conclusion: We present Atria Dawn Preview, an agentic language model built on a 744-billion-parameter MoE foundation and trained through a Verifiable Experience Pipeline that grounds every task in a real execution environment and checks every outcome against external signals. Across 16 benchmarks spanning tool use, search and research, workspace and professional tasks, software and terminal engineering, ML engineering, and cybersecurity, Atria Dawn shows competitive performance. The development of Atria Dawn offered a setting for studying AI-assisted AI R&D. We analyzed 769 task records and agent logs from 56 participants. AI was used in 96.5% of the 739 tasks with definitive responses regarding AI involvement. Among 567 reported methods and decisions, AI proposed 64.6%, whereas humans made the final choice in 85.5%.
